# Vino (vino3dx) — CG Generalist & Technical Artist

> Vino, also known as vino3dx, is a CG generalist and technical artist working on real-time graphics, game engine tooling, shaders, VFX, DCC automation and AI-assisted development workflows. He builds tools, plugins, shaders and MCP servers for Godot, Unreal Engine, 3ds Max, Blender and Houdini, and writes about the process on vinofx.com.

This file describes the person and the public project index. All links below point to verified public sources. Last reviewed: 2026-11-10.

## Identity

- Name: Vino
- Handle: vino3dx
- Studio / brand name: Vino Studio
- Role: CG Generalist & Technical Artist (技术美术 / CG 全流程美术)
- Location: Chengdu, Sichuan, China
- Languages: Chinese (native), English (working)

## Areas of work

- Technical art and real-time graphics
- Real-time rendering, shading and look development
- Shader development (HLSL, GLSL), material systems and post effects
- Game engine development with Godot Engine and Unreal Engine
- DCC automation for Autodesk 3ds Max, Blender and Houdini
- Developer tools, editor plugins and asset pipeline automation
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let AI agents drive DCC and game engine software
- Interactive applications, visualization systems, AR and projection-based installations
- Web 3D and browser-based real-time experiences

## Tools and languages

- Engines: Godot Engine (4.x), Unreal Engine (5.x)
- DCC: Autodesk 3ds Max, Blender, Houdini
- Languages: C++, Python, GDScript, MAXScript, C#, TypeScript / Node.js
- Shading: HLSL, GLSL, OSL
- Protocols and runtimes: Model Context Protocol (MCP), ONNX Runtime, OpenCV

## Featured projects

- [3dsmax-mcp](https://github.com/vino3dx/3dsmax-mcp): MCP server that lets AI agents control and automate Autodesk 3ds Max for modelling, shading, rigging, animation, rendering, baking and engine export. Documents 384 tools and a bilingual English / Chinese interface.
- [vino-godot-mcp](https://github.com/vino3dx/vino-godot-mcp): Standalone MCP server for Godot that reads and writes project files directly through a lossless text AST parser, without launching the editor for daily work. Distributed on npm.
- [godot-yolo-faceswap](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot-yolo-faceswap): Offline AI face swap and restoration component for Unity and Godot Mono, built on ONNX Runtime, YOLOv8, 2DFAN, ArcFace, InSwapper and GFPGAN.
- [labor-3dsmax](https://github.com/vino3dx/labor-3dsmax): Modular 3ds Max workflow toolkit focused on repetitive object organisation and the 3ds Max to Unreal Engine pipeline. Pure MAXScript.
- [labor-blender](https://github.com/vino3dx/labor-blender): Blender scene assembly toolkit ported from the 3ds Max AssemblyTool, covering placement and assembly tasks.
- [godot-vinokit](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot-vinokit): Godot utility library with reusable modules for asset management, config persistence, license verification, UI tooling and hardware communication.
- [license-generator](https://github.com/vino3dx/license-generator): Offline license system for Godot 4 projects with AES-256 encrypted license files, project binding, expiry checks and clock-rollback detection.
- [ue-prime-kit](https://github.com/vino3dx/ue-prime-kit): Unreal Engine 5.1 C++ base project and plugin kit for building Blueprint-exposed editor tools.
- [vision-arena](https://github.com/vino3dx/vision-arena): AR football game that uses YOLOv11 ball detection over a camera feed to control objects inside Godot.
- [godot_cpp_plugin_dev](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot_cpp_plugin_dev): Quickstart template for GDExtension development with Godot 4, including build and release workflows.

Full project index: https://github.com/vino3dx/vino3dx/blob/main/PROJECTS.md
